name: sigma-authoring
description: The canonical Sigma authoring skills every migration converter defers to for the current spec surface: sigma-api (authentication), sigma-workbooks (workbook spec — element kinds, source kinds, controls, formulas, formatting, layout), sigma-data-models (data model authoring), custom-sql-to-data-model, and sigma-cross-org-port (copy a workbook between Sigma orgs that already share the underlying data). Install this alongside any converter — the converters assume it is present.
